lines.en: label iodorm10:
I knock on Io’s door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Io 的门，等她来应门。

lines.en: I’m sure I’ll need to knock again or announce my presence at some point to circumnavigate her antisocial tendencies but-
lines.zh: 我肯定待会儿还得再敲一次、或者出声表明自己来了，好绕过她那反社交的毛病——不过——

lines.en: I see no harm in testing the waters each time I arrive.
lines.zh: 我觉得每次来都试探一下也无妨。

lines.en: It’s only a matter of time until that shell of hers crumbles and she winds up greeting anyone who knocks.
lines.zh: 她那层壳迟早会碎掉，到那时谁来敲门她都会去应。

lines.en: If anyone knocks.
lines.zh: 如果还有人来敲的话。

lines.en: There’s no reason anyone would want to at this point, is there?
lines.zh: 到了这一步，也没什么理由会有人想来了，不是吗？

lines.en: No one but me, that is.
lines.zh: 除了我，也就是说。

lines.en: And it’s not like it’s flattering receiving a visit from me given that my end goal with all of these girls is exactly the same.
lines.zh: 再说，被我拜访也算不上什么荣幸——毕竟我对所有这些女生的最终目标都一模一样。

lines.en: To sneak inside of them- in more ways than one.
lines.zh: 溜进她们里面——不止一种意义上的。

lines.en: Into their minds. Into their hearts.
lines.zh: 溜进她们的头脑。溜进她们的心。

lines.en: Into their sheets.
lines.zh: 溜进她们的床单。

lines.en: Their pants.
lines.zh: 她们的裤子。

lines.en: Their bodies.
lines.zh: 她们的身体。

lines.en: And to leave minimal trace behind so my efforts aren’t thwarted somewhere along the line I’m actively trying to erase.
lines.zh: 然后留下尽可能少的痕迹，好让我在正努力抹去的那条线上，不至于哪里出了岔子。

lines.en: If you think that’s so horrible-
lines.zh: 如果你觉得这很可怕——

lines.en: Then just look away.
lines.zh: 那就把眼睛移开。

lines.en: It’s that easy.
lines.zh: 就这么简单。

lines.en: : Io, it’s me.
lines.zh: : Io，是我。

lines.en: : Say that after the first knock from now on.
lines.zh: : 以后第一下敲完就这么说。

lines.en: : Come on in, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 请进吧，Sensei。

lines.en: scene black
I probably {i}should{/i} just say I’m here after the first knock, shouldn’t I?
lines.zh: 我大概{i}应该{/i}在第一下敲完就报上名来，对吧？

lines.en: If my goal is so impure, is the pause to see if she’s grown as a person really all that necessary?
lines.zh: 既然我的目的如此不纯，那停下来看看她有没有成长为一个更好的人，真的有必要吗？

lines.en: Time is precious.
lines.zh: 时间很宝贵。

lines.en: Or at least it used to be.
lines.zh: 至少以前是。

lines.en: But I could still save so much of it by giving up on her.
lines.zh: 可我要是放弃她，还是能省下大把时间。

lines.en: scene iodormten1
: Welcome back.
lines.zh: : 欢迎回来。

lines.en: So why won't I do that?
lines.zh: 那我为什么不肯这么做呢？

lines.en: : Hey. Any plans for tonight?
lines.zh: : 嘿。今晚有什么打算？

lines.en: : Not until now.
lines.zh: : 在你来之前没有。

lines.en: : Was thinking about taking a trip to the convenience store but my shoes are still soaking wet from walking home in the snow.
lines.zh: : 本来想去趟便利店的，可我那双鞋踩雪走回家还没干透。

lines.en: : You only have one pair?
lines.zh: : 你只有一双鞋？

lines.en: : I only need one pair.
lines.zh: : 我只需要一双。

lines.en: : Clearly not if shoes are currently your only barrier from fulfilling your nightly goal.
lines.zh: : 显然不是——如果鞋子现在是你实现每晚目标的唯一障碍的话。

lines.en: scene iodormten2
: Okay, sorry. I {i}usually{/i} only need one pair.
lines.zh: : 好吧，抱歉。{i}平时{/i}我确实只需要一双。

lines.en: : But it’s not like the inability to go on a little walk is something that’s going to ruin my life.
lines.zh: : 可不能出去走一小段这种事，也不至于毁了我的人生。

lines.en: scene iodormten3
: Especially now that you’re here.
lines.zh: : 尤其是现在你来了。

lines.en: : You’re a little bit more fun than a trek through frozen rain.
lines.zh: : 你比在冻雨里跋涉有意思那么一点点。

lines.en: : Just a little, though.
lines.zh: : 不过就一点点。

lines.en: : Thanks. I also like you more than I like snow, if that means anything to you.
lines.zh: : 谢了。我也喜欢你比喜欢雪多一点，如果这对你有意义的话。

lines.en: : It does.
: I have a tendency to think everyone likes everything more than me by default until proven otherwise.
lines.zh: : 我有个毛病，就是默认所有人都喜欢别的东西胜过喜欢我，除非有证据证明不是这样。

lines.en: : Well I’m not really in the mood to list all of the things you’re better than, so we should probably just change the topic now.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我没兴致去列举你比哪些东西强，所以我们大概该换个话题了。

lines.en: scene iodormten2
: Hahah...Probably.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……大概吧。

lines.en: scene iodormten4
: So, what do you want to do?
lines.zh: : 那么，你想做点什么？

lines.en: : You came all the way here with just your regular blazer on. Aren’t you cold?
lines.zh: : 你一路过来就穿了件普通西装外套。不冷吗？

lines.en: : I’d offer you a jacket or something but I’m pretty sure that nothing I have would fit you.
lines.zh: : 我是想借你件外套什么的，但我敢肯定我这儿没有一件你穿得上。

lines.en: : We can get under the kotatsu if you want?
lines.zh: : 要不我们钻到暖桌底下去？

lines.en: : It doesn’t turn on since I’m still trying to fix it, but it’s got a blanket and blankets are cool.
lines.zh: : 它不通电，因为我还在修，不过上面盖着毯子，而毯子很酷。

lines.en: : Well, warm. They’re not cool at all. You know what I mean.
lines.zh: : 呃，是暖和。一点也不酷。你懂我意思。

lines.en: : There’s the bed, too.
lines.zh: : 还有床。

lines.en: : Yes. There’s the bed, too.
lines.zh: : 是啊。还有床。

lines.en: : If you can reach it, that is.
lines.zh: : 前提是你够得到。

lines.en: : You’re gonna have to climb over some stuff to get there so I figured a spot on the floor might be easier for you.
lines.zh: : 你得翻过一堆东西才能到那儿，所以我琢磨着，你在地上找个位置可能更省事。

lines.en: : Are you doubting my agility, Io Ichimonji?
lines.zh: : 你是在怀疑我的身手吗，Io Ichimonji？

lines.en: scene iodormten5
: Woah. Breaking out my last name? You must be really serious right now.
lines.zh: : 哇哦。都搬出我的姓了？你今晚是认真的啊。

lines.en: : Never underestimate my willpower to get into bed with a cute girl.
lines.zh: : 永远别低估我想和可爱女孩上床的意志力。

lines.en: scene iodormten6
: Ooooh I’ve moved from “bathhouse attendant” to “cute girl” in your book. What a momentous occasion.
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦，我在你心里的称呼从「澡堂服务员」升级成「可爱女孩」了。这可是个历史性时刻。

lines.en: : You’ve held both titles since I met you.
lines.zh: : 从认识你那天起，这两个头衔你都一直挂着。

lines.en: : {i}I’m flattered you feel that way, Sensei, but I’m sure it’s just your craving for body heat that is causing you to say such things.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Sensei 你这么想我很荣幸，但我敢肯定，你之所以说这种话，只是因为你想蹭体温。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}So I’m sorry but I must reject you. I hope we can stay friends, though.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}所以抱歉，我必须拒绝你。不过希望我们还能做朋友。{/i}

lines.en: : And with that, you’ve earned the title of “Uta impressionist” as well.
lines.zh: : 就凭这一句，你又多了个「Uta 模仿者」的头衔。

lines.en: scene iodormten7
: Nihihi~ Pretty good, right? I spend so much time with her that it’s basically second nature at this point.
lines.zh: : 嘻嘻嘻~ 挺像的吧？我跟她待的时间太长了，现在基本上已经成第二天性了。

lines.en: scene iodormten8
: Come on. We can sit on the bed.
lines.zh: : 来吧。我们可以坐床上。

lines.en: : As long as you can get to it, I mean~
lines.zh: : 前提是你能爬过来，我是说~

lines.en: scene black
Io manages to slip between a table and a minifridge without bumping into either of them and hops onto her mattress.
lines.zh: Io 从一张桌子和一个小冰箱之间挤了过去，哪边都没碰到，然后跳上了她的床垫。

lines.en: I am slightly less successful but still manage to make it through without breaking anything, so this is a victory in my book.
lines.zh: 我就没那么利落了，不过好歹也过来了，什么都没弄坏——所以在我看来这就是胜利。

lines.en: scene iodormten9
: Congratulations on passing through the barrier.
lines.zh: : 恭喜你闯过了那道关卡。

lines.en: : I’m impressed you were able to make it through without even touching anything.
lines.zh: : 你居然一点东西都没碰到就过来了，我挺佩服的。

lines.en: : I’m like five feet tall and paperthin. Plus I’ve done it a bunch of times before.
lines.zh: : 我才五英尺高，瘦得像张纸。而且以前做过好多次了。

lines.en: : Muscle memory really helps out with small things like that.
lines.zh: : 肌肉记忆在这种小事上真的帮大忙。

lines.en: : Also, it’s not weird if I sit this close to you, is it?
lines.zh: : 还有，我坐得离你这么近不奇怪吧？

lines.en: : You’re not getting nervous, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不会紧张吧？

lines.en: : Not at all.
lines.zh: : 一点都不。

lines.en: : Are you?
lines.zh: : 你呢？

lines.en: : Not at all.
lines.zh: : 一点都不。

lines.en: : I'm just chilling.
lines.zh: : 我就是放松一下。

lines.en: : Wanna watch a movie or something? I’ve got a bunch.
lines.zh: : 想看个电影什么的吗？我有一大堆。

lines.en: : I already told you I’m not into movies.
lines.zh: : 我说过了，我不爱看电影。

lines.en: : Yeah, but I’m obviously gonna try to change your mind when they’re another big hobby of mine.
lines.zh: : 是说过，可这明明是我的另一大爱好，我当然要想办法让你改变主意。

lines.en: : You have too many hobbies.
lines.zh: : 你的爱好太多了。

lines.en: : You don’t have enough hobbies.
lines.zh: : 你的爱好太少了。

lines.en: : Take something up so we can have a reason to hang out more.
lines.zh: : 你也培养一个吧，这样我们就有理由多待在一起了。

lines.en: : I was unaware that we needed a reason to hang out more.
lines.zh: : 我不知道我们多待在一起还需要理由。

lines.en: : Less of a reason and more of an excuse so that no one will start thinking anything is going on between us.
lines.zh: : 与其说是理由，不如说是借口——这样就不会有人开始觉得我们之间有什么。

lines.en: : If we’re both in like...the golf club or something, nobody will think we’re up to anything if we hang out somewhere after[school].
lines.zh: : 比如我们俩都在……高尔夫社什么的，那[school]放学后我们待在一起，谁也不会觉得我们在搞什么名堂。

lines.en: : At this point, I think it’s pretty safe to assume that anyone and everyone thinks I’m up to something at any given point.
lines.zh: : 到了这一步，我觉得可以很安全地假定：无论何时，所有人、任何人都觉得我在搞什么名堂。

lines.en: : Being around me probably just opens you up to more pressure like that.
lines.zh: : 跟我在一起，大概只会让你承受更多这种压力。

lines.en: scene iodormten10
: I don’t care about pressure but...
lines.zh: : 我不在乎压力，不过……

lines.en: : Is that really what everyone thinks of you?
lines.zh: : 大家真的是这么看你的吗？

lines.en: : That you’re up to something?
lines.zh: : 觉得你在搞什么名堂？

lines.en: : You’re not, though. Right?
lines.zh: : 可你并没有，对吧？

lines.en: : And even if you were, isn’t it a little obsessive of them to not let you do what you want to do?
lines.zh: : 就算你真的在搞什么，他们不让你做自己想做的事，是不是也有点太偏执了？

lines.en: : You’re an adult. You don’t have to care about what a bunch of [teenage]girls think. They-
lines.zh: : 你是成年人。你不用在意一群[teenage]女孩怎么想。她们——

lines.en: : They’re toxic, yes. I already know how you feel.
lines.zh: : 她们很毒，对。我已经知道你怎么想的了。

lines.en: : You’ve mentioned it a few times now.
lines.zh: : 你已经提过好几次了。

lines.en: scene iodormten11
: ...Yeah.
: You know, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，Sensei……

lines.en: : I’ve got a lot going on and I’m by no means perfect-
lines.zh: : 我身上问题一大堆，也绝对算不上完美——

lines.en: : But I’d never do something like judge you for hanging out with whoever you want to hang out with.
lines.zh: : 但我绝不会因为你跟谁待在一起就评判你。

lines.en: : That’s your prerogative.
lines.zh: : 那是你的特权。

lines.en: : That’s not true and you know it.
lines.zh: : 这不是实话，你心里清楚。

lines.en: scene iodormten12
: It’s human nature to get jealous of things you don’t have- or things you want.
lines.zh: : 嫉妒自己没有的东西——或者想要的东西，是人的本性。

lines.en: : It’s clear you want to spend as much time with me as possible, so you’d obviously judge me if I just abandoned you for other girls.
lines.zh: : 很明显你想尽可能多地跟我待在一起，所以我要是为了别的女生把你抛下，你肯定会评判我。

lines.en: scene iodormten13
: Yeah, you’re probably right.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你大概是对的。

lines.en: : I don’t think I’d ever say anything about it, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得我什么都不会说。

lines.en: : That’s because you’re a coward.
lines.zh: : 那是因为你是个胆小鬼。

lines.en: : I know.
lines.zh: : 我知道。

lines.en: : And you’re weak.
lines.zh: : 而且你很软弱。

lines.en: : Uh-huh...
lines.zh: : 嗯哼……

lines.en: : And you have stupid hair.
lines.zh: : 而且你的头发很蠢。

lines.en: scene iodormten14
: Okay, now you’re just being mean.
lines.zh: : 好了，你现在纯粹是在欺负人了。

lines.en: scene iodormten15
Io moves closer to me and rests her head on my shoulder- something people don’t normally do after you insult them.
lines.zh: Io 又往我这边凑了凑，把头靠在我肩膀上——一般来说，被人骂过之后可不会这么做。

lines.en: Granted, I was just kidding for the most part. But it’s still a strange reaction either way.
lines.zh: 当然，我大部分时候是在开玩笑。但不管怎么说，这反应还是挺奇怪的。

lines.en: : You can keep making fun of me if you want. I don’t mind.
lines.zh: : 你想继续取笑我就取笑吧。我不介意。

lines.en: : Sure but-
lines.zh: : 行是行，不过——

lines.en: : This is okay, right? Even though I’m a weak coward with stupid hair?
lines.zh: : 这样没问题吧？就算我是个头发很蠢的软弱胆小鬼？

lines.en: : There’s nothing cowardly about making a move like this on your teacher.
lines.zh: : 敢对自己的老师做出这种举动，可一点都不胆小。

lines.en: : You’re right. I’m actually kind of awesome, aren’t I?
lines.zh: : 你说得对。我其实还挺厉害的，对吧？

lines.en: : You’re definitely unique, if not anything else.
lines.zh: : 就算别的都不算，你绝对是独一无二的。

lines.en: scene iodormten16
: That’s far from a compliment, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 这可算不上什么好话，Sensei。

lines.en: : Being unique can be a death sentence sometimes.
lines.zh: : 与众不同有时候等于被判死刑。

lines.en: : Also, you don’t actually think my hair is stupid, do you?
lines.zh: : 还有，你其实不觉得我的头发蠢吧？

lines.en: : It’s like, one of the three things I like about myself.
lines.zh: : 这可是我喜欢自己的三件事之一。

lines.en: : What are the other two?
lines.zh: : 另外两件呢？

lines.en: : My eyes and how I can still get out of bed in the morning.
lines.zh: : 我的眼睛，还有我早上还能爬得起来。

lines.en: : That last one is a little more real than I was expecting, but I get it.
lines.zh: : 最后那件比我预想的要现实得多，不过我懂。

lines.en: : Do you have three things you like about yourself, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei 你有三件喜欢自己的地方吗？

lines.en: : I’m not even sure I have {i}one{/i}.
lines.zh: : 我连{i}一件{/i}都不确定有没有。

lines.en: scene iodormten17
: And you call {i}me{/i} a coward. That’s the most cowardly thing I’ve ever heard.
lines.zh: : 你还说{i}我{/i}是胆小鬼。这可是我听过最胆小的话了。

lines.en: : Everyone has {i}something{/i} they like about themselves. Even if it’s something small like how you look in a particular photo or how your voice sounds when you sing in the shower.
lines.zh: : 每个人都有喜欢自己的{i}地方{/i}。哪怕只是很小的事，比如某张照片里的自己有多好看，或者洗澡时唱歌的声音有多好听。

lines.en: : There’s gotta be something in there.
lines.zh: : 里面总该有点什么吧。

lines.en: : I’ve already found plenty of stuff I like about you.
lines.zh: : 我已经找到了不少喜欢你的地方。

lines.en: : Name one.
lines.zh: : 说一个。

lines.en: : Your shoulder’s really comfortable. And warm.
lines.zh: : 你的肩膀很舒服。而且很暖和。

lines.en: : And I like how you still come talk to me despite me being overbearing and annoyingly sensitive.
lines.zh: : 还有，尽管我又缠人又敏感得烦人，你还是愿意来跟我说话，这点我喜欢。

lines.en: : Yeah. You’re kind of hard to talk to at times.
lines.zh: : 是啊。你有时候还挺难聊的。

lines.en: : True. But at least I'm more interesting than the rest of the girls in class, right?
lines.zh: : 确实。但至少我比班里其他女生有意思，对吧？

lines.en: : I mean, why else would you be here tonight instead of with any of them?
lines.zh: : 我是说，不然你今晚为什么在这儿，而不是跟她们中的任何一个在一起？

lines.en: : Not to mention, I haven’t even seen you with that one blonde girl again since the two of you showed up at the bathhouse.
lines.zh: : 更别说，自从你俩出现在澡堂那次之后，我就再没见过你和那个金发女孩在一起。

lines.en: scene iodormten18
: Are you bored of her now that you have me?
lines.zh: : 有了我，你就对她腻了吗？

lines.en: : I’ve gotta say, I kind of get it.
lines.zh: : 我得说，我有点理解。

lines.en: : She seemed a little too plain anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正她看起来也太平淡了点。

lines.en: : Pretty, but plain.
lines.zh: : 漂亮是漂亮，就是平淡。

lines.en: : Obviously, I’m sure there’s a lot more to it than that.
lines.zh: : 当然，我肯定她远不止如此。

lines.en: : But even the fact that you’re letting me rest my head on your shoulder like this-
lines.zh: : 但光是你能让我这样把头靠在你肩膀上这件事——

lines.en: : What are you doing?
lines.zh: : 你在干什么？

lines.en: scene iodormten19
: Hm?
: What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？

lines.en: : Aren’t we bonding?
lines.zh: : 我们不是在增进感情吗？

lines.en: : Did I say something wrong?
lines.zh: : 我说错什么了吗？

lines.en: : This is your idea of bonding?
lines.zh: : 这就是你理解的增进感情？

lines.en: : Talking down about people you’ve never even spoken with?
lines.zh: : 贬低那些你连话都没说过的人？

lines.en: : That blonde girl's name is Ayane and she’s far from plain.
lines.zh: : 那个金发女孩叫 Ayane，她远远算不上平淡。

lines.en: : She’s actually one of the most unique people I’ve ever met.
lines.zh: : 她其实是我见过最独特的人之一。

lines.en: scene iodormten20
: Wait, I wasn’t trying to talk down on her. I was just...
lines.zh: : 等等，我不是想贬低她。我只是……

lines.en: : Just what?
lines.zh: : 只是什么？

lines.en: : I...I was just trying to make you think I was...more interesting.
lines.zh: : 我……我只是想让你觉得我……更有意思。

lines.en: : There are ways to do that without making everyone else seem small.
lines.zh: : 想做到这一点，有很多办法，不必把别人说得一文不值。

lines.en: : You’re underestimating how much you’ve impressed me so far.
lines.zh: : 你低估了到目前为止你给我留下的印象有多深。

lines.en: : Don’t ruin all of that by belittling people you know nothing about.
lines.zh: : 别因为贬低你根本不了解的人，把这一切都毁了。

lines.en: scene iodormten21
The caterpillar squirms once more.
lines.zh: 毛毛虫又扭动了一下。

lines.en: : I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 对不起。

lines.en: : There’s no sense in apologizing to me.
lines.zh: : 跟我道歉没意义。

lines.en: : Just think more about what you’re saying before you actually say it.
lines.zh: : 说话之前多想想自己要说什么就行。

lines.en: : You’re smart. Bad with people, maybe, but really...really smart.
lines.zh: : 你很聪明。也许不太擅长跟人相处，但真的……真的很聪明。

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : You’re better than this. That’s all I’m saying.
lines.zh: : 你不该是这样的。我就是这个意思。

lines.en: scene iodormten22
: Well...
: Why are you here, then?
lines.zh: : 那你怎么还在这儿？

lines.en: : If there are other interesting people who don’t do things like talk down on everyone around them, why come {i}here{/i}?
lines.zh: : 如果还有别的有意思的人、不会贬低身边所有人，那你为什么来{i}这儿{/i}？

lines.en: : I just...thought there was a reason for it. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 我只是……觉得这背后该有个理由。就这样。

lines.en: : I’m here because I wanted to be here.
lines.zh: : 我来这儿，是因为我想来。

lines.en: : Don’t overthink it or try to turn it into some sort of equation that needs to be solved.
lines.zh: : 别想太多，也别把它变成一道需要解的方程式。

lines.en: : Not everything happens for a reason. Sometimes things just...happen.
lines.zh: : 不是所有事都有原因的。有时候事情就是……发生了。

lines.en: scene iodormten23
: Sometimes...things just happen...
lines.zh: : 有时候……事情就是发生了……

lines.en: : I messed up big time, didn’t I?
lines.zh: : 我搞砸得挺厉害的，对吧？

lines.en: scene iodormten24
: Yeah.
lines.zh: : 是啊。

lines.en: : But you’re still learning.
lines.zh: : 但你还在学。

lines.en: : Just don’t be a bitch and everything will work out fine.
lines.zh: : 只要别当个婊子，一切都会好起来的。

lines.en: : I like the head patting thing but not so much the being called a bitch part.
lines.zh: : 摸头我很喜欢，被叫婊子就不太喜欢了。

lines.en: : I guess I deserve it, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我大概也是活该。

lines.en: : Either way, please don’t stop. That feels really nice.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，请别停。真的很舒服。

lines.en: scene iodormten25
I leave my hand on Io’s head for reasons beyond my comprehension...but I feel like a good portion of them are simply due to how cute she is.
lines.zh: 我把手留在 Io 的头上，理由连我自己都搞不懂……但我觉得其中很大一部分，只是因为她太可爱了。

lines.en: Frankly, though...I’m actually kind of mad right now.
lines.zh: 不过说实话……我现在其实有点生气。

lines.en: It’s one thing to not associate with any of the other girls- a thing I can understand and respect.
lines.zh: 不跟其他女生来往是一回事——这点我能理解，也能尊重。

lines.en: But to do something like demean them behind their backs without even attempting to understand where they come from-
lines.zh: 可像那样在背后贬低她们，连试着去理解她们的来处都不肯——

lines.en: Isn’t that exactly why Io dislikes girls in the first place?
lines.zh: 这不正是 Io 一开始讨厌女生的原因吗？

lines.en: Because they start unnecessary drama?
lines.zh: 就因为她们会挑起没必要的破事？

lines.en: Is she really this desperate for affection?
lines.zh: 她真的渴求关爱到这个地步了吗？

lines.en: Or is it something else?
lines.zh: 还是说，是别的什么？

lines.en: Something I don’t understand yet.
lines.zh: 某种我还不明白的东西。

lines.en: scene black
I don’t stay much longer after that, but not because I don’t want to.
lines.zh: 之后我没待太久，但不是因为我不想待。

lines.en: Io actually asks me to leave so she can get a head start on some new thing she wants to build.
lines.zh: 其实是 Io 让我走的，她想抢先动手做一个新的东西。

lines.en: I try asking what she plans on making, but she hurries me out of the room in suspiciously quick fashion.
lines.zh: 我试着问她打算做什么，可她催着我出门，那速度快得可疑。

lines.en: It is what it is, though.
lines.zh: 不过，也就这样了。

lines.en: I’m not interested in dampening her creative process when she seems weirdly motivated all of a sudden.
lines.zh: 她突然这么有干劲，我可不想给她创作的过程泼冷水。

lines.en: I just hope that whatever it is she makes doesn’t wind up collecting dust on her shelf for the rest of eternity.
lines.zh: 我只希望她做的那个东西，别最后又落到架子上永远积灰。
